surface: Positioning (`useFloating`, ref-aware `arrow`, the `@floating-ui/dom` middleware re-exports including deprecated `inner`, and the floating tree), the full interaction-hook set (`useInteractions`, `useHover` + `safePolygon`, `useClick`, `useFocus`, `useDismiss`, `useRole`, `useClientPoint`, `useListNavigation`, `useTypeahead`, and deprecated `useInnerOffset`), the component layer (`FloatingPortal`, `FloatingOverlay`, `FloatingFocusManager`, `FloatingArrow`, `FloatingList`, `Composite`), and transitions plus both delay-group APIs.
divergences: `ref-as-prop`: React forwardRef component APIs become Octane ref-as-prop APIs.
ssr: No dedicated SSR/hydration lane; the supported claims are client positioning and interactions.
notes: The pinned @floating-ui/react@0.27.19 unit suite executes 286 passing assertions with 6 matching upstream skips on both pristine React and adapted Octane lanes; the upstream type program is also compiled on both sides.
